§6Dark Fusion Core (DFC)§f

§aThe ultimate reactor. GHEs per tick. One mistake and it takes out a huge area.§f

The DFC is the most powerful reactor in NTM. Components are forged in the Plasma Forge with welded osmiridium plates.

§6Core types§f: Vibrant Singularity (500x), Tiny Wormhole (650x), Eye of Harmony (800x), Thingy (2500x).

§6Fuels§f ranked by energy multiplier: Antischrabidium (2.7), BF Rocket Fuel (2.5), Antimatter (2.2), Schrabidium trisulfide (2.0), Tritium (1.7), Deuterium/Xenon (1.5), Poisonous mud (1.4), Liquid oxygen (1.2), Liquid hydrogen (1.0).

§6Power formula§f: P = (w x 100) x f1 x f2 x c x 95000, where w = emitter input (0-100%), f1/f2 = fuel multipliers, c = core multiplier.

§6Setup§f: Place fuel injector at core position, receiver or tungsten crate within 15 blocks, emitter and stabilizers at matching height, core on top of injector. Compact 3x3 designs are possible.

§cWARNING:§f The beam deals 50 damage and destroys most blocks. The core sets nearby entities on fire. Never approach without Fau armor.

§ePS:§f Start with Vibrant Singularity and basic fuel (Deuterium + Liquid Oxygen). Scale up from there.
